text_en: A false balance is an abomination to the Lord , but an accurate weight is his delight.
text_cn: 上主深恶假秤，却喜爱砝码准确。

text_en: When pride comes, then comes disgrace; but wisdom is with the humble.
text_cn: 傲慢来到，耻辱随后而至；智慧只与谦逊人相处。

text_en: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the crookedness of the treacherous destroys them.
text_cn: 正直的人，以正义为领导；背义的人，必为邪恶所毁灭。

text_en: Riches do not profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
text_cn: 在上主盛怒之日，财富毫无用途；只有正义，能救人免于死亡。

text_en: The righteousness of the blameless keeps their ways straight, but the wicked fall by their own wickedness.
text_cn: 完人的正义，为他修平道路；恶人必因自己的邪恶而颠仆。

text_en: The righteousness of the upright saves them, but the treacherous are taken captive by their schemes.
text_cn: 正直的人，将因自己的正义而获救；奸诈的人，反为自己的恶计所连累。

text_en: When the wicked die, their hope perishes, and the expectation of the godless comes to nothing.
text_cn: 恶人一死，他的希望尽成泡影；同样，奸匪的期待也全然消失。

text_en: The righteous are delivered from trouble, and the wicked get into it instead.
text_cn: 义人得免患难，恶人反来顶替。

text_en: With their mouths the godless would destroy their neighbors, but by knowledge the righteous are delivered.
text_cn: 假善人以口舌，伤害自己的近人；义人因有知识，却得以保全。

text_en: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices; and when the wicked perish, there is jubilation.
text_cn: 几时义人幸运，全城欢腾；几时恶人灭亡，欢声四起。

text_en: By the blessing of the upright a city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
text_cn: 义人的祝福，使城市兴隆；恶人的口舌，使城市倾覆。

text_en: Whoever belittles another lacks sense, but an intelligent person remains silent.
text_cn: 嘲弄自己朋友的人，毫无识趣；有见识的人，必沉默寡言。

text_en: A gossip goes about telling secrets, but one who is trustworthy in spirit keeps a confidence.
text_cn: 往来传话的人，必泄漏秘密；心地诚朴的人，方能不露实情。

text_en: Where there is no guidance, a nation falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.
text_cn: 人民缺乏领导，势必衰弱，人民的得救，正在于谋士众多。

text_en: To guarantee loans for a stranger brings trouble, but there is safety in refusing to do so.
text_cn: 为外人作保的，必自讨苦吃；厌恶作保的，必自享安全。

text_en: A gracious woman gets honor, but she who hates virtue is covered with shame. The timid become destitute, but the aggressive gain riches.
text_cn: 淑德的妇女，必为丈夫取得光荣；恼恨正义的妇女，正是一耻辱的宝座；懒散的人失落自己的财物，勤谨的人反取得财富。

text_en: Those who are kind reward themselves, but the cruel do themselves harm.
text_cn: 为人慈善，是造福己身；残酷的人，反自伤己命。

text_en: The wicked earn no real gain, but those who sow righteousness get a true reward.
text_cn: 恶人所赚得的工资，是空虚的；播种正义者的报酬，才是真实的。

text_en: Whoever is steadfast in righteousness will live, but whoever pursues evil will die.
text_cn: 恒行正义，必走向生命；追求邪恶，必自趋丧亡。

text_en: Crooked minds are an abomination to the Lord , but those of blameless ways are his delight.
text_cn: 上主憎恶心邪的人，喜悦举止无瑕的人。

text_en: Be assured, the wicked will not go unpunished, but those who are righteous will escape.
text_cn: 恶人始终不能逃避惩罚，义人的后裔必获得拯救。

text_en: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout is a beautiful woman without good sense.
text_cn: 女人美丽而不精明，犹如套在猪鼻上的金环。

text_en: The desire of the righteous ends only in good; the expectation of the wicked in wrath.
text_cn: 义人的心愿必获善报；恶人的希望终归破灭。

text_en: Some give freely, yet grow all the richer; others withhold what is due, and only suffer want.
text_cn: 有人慷慨好施，反更富有；有人过于吝啬，反更贫穷。

text_en: A generous person will be enriched, and one who gives water will get water.
text_cn: 慈善为怀的人，必得富裕；施惠于人的人，必蒙施惠。

text_en: The people curse those who hold back grain, but a blessing is on the head of those who sell it.
text_cn: 屯积粮食的人，必受人民诅咒；祝福却降在卖粮食者的头上。

text_en: Whoever diligently seeks good seeks favor, but evil comes to the one who searches for it.
text_cn: 慕求美善的，必求得恩宠；追求邪恶的，邪恶必临其身。

text_en: Those who trust in their riches will wither, but the righteous will flourish like green leaves.
text_cn: 信赖自己财富的人，必至衰落；义人却茂盛有如绿叶。

text_en: Those who trouble their households will inherit wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise.
text_cn: 危害自己家庭的，必承受虚幻；愚昧的人，必作心智者的奴隶。

text_en: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, but violence takes lives away.
text_cn: 义人的果实是生命树，智慧的人能夺取人心。

text_en: If the righteous are repaid on earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
text_cn: 看义人在地上还遭受报复，恶人和罪人更将如何？
